name: Martinaise 公寓楼
blurb: 西南入口后的楼道潮湿、狭窄，墙后传来住户的声音。这里能问到阳台抽烟人的门牌，也能继续往楼上找 28 号门。

points.label: 西南入口的金属门
points.show_when: CheckItem("key_apartment_building") == false and Variable["TASK.find_a_way_inside_apt_building"] == true and Variable["TASK.find_a_way_inside_apt_building_done"] == false

points.label: 28 号金属门
points.show_when: Variable["TASK.find_apartment_twenty_eight"] == true and Variable["TASK.find_apartment_twenty_eight_done"] == false and Variable["TASK.talk_to_smoker_again_done"] == false and Variable["TASK.interview_the_sunday_friend_done"] == false and (IsHourBetween(21,4) and DayCount() >= 2 and IsTaskActive("TASK.visit_the_smoker_on_the_balcony")) == false

points.label: 28 号门后的抽烟人
points.show_when: Variable["TASK.find_apartment_twenty_eight"] == true and Variable["TASK.talk_to_smoker_again_done"] == false and Variable["TASK.interview_the_sunday_friend_done"] == false and IsHourBetween(21,4) and DayCount() >= 2 and IsTaskActive("TASK.visit_the_smoker_on_the_balcony")

points.label: 走廊尽头 · de Ruyter 家的门
points.show_when: Variable["TASK.get_speed"] == true or Variable["TASK.get_drugs_from_cunos_apartment"] == true or Variable["TASK.retry_cuno_door"] == true

points.label: 12 号房——链子已剪，进去找 Cuno 的爸爸
points.show_when: Variable["apt.cuno_dad_door_interfacing_white_check_succeeded"] == true and (Variable["TASK.get_speed"] == true or Variable["TASK.get_drugs_from_cunos_apartment"] == true or Variable["TASK.retry_cuno_door"] == true)
